title: Opening at broker-average cost with no acquisition date is sold: gain known, term unknown -> FY 2025-26 incomplete
rules: Income-tax Act 1961 s.48: gain computable from the known (true average) cost
Income-tax Act 1961 s.2(42A): short/long cannot be determined without the acquisition date -> rate (15/20 % vs 10/12.5 %) and s.112A threshold use unknown
Brief rule: FY with an unclassifiable disposal -> complete false, tax/cess/total null
derivation: Opening 2025-04-01: 100 units @ 300.00, meta cost_basis broker_average, no acquired date -> cost 30,000.00, date unknown.

Gain on the stated cost = 45,000 - 30,000 = 15,000.00 (fmv_2018 is null, so no grandfathering adjustment is applied; if the shares were in fact bought before 1-Feb-2018 s.55(2)(ac) could change the taxable gain - see INDEX.md).
Term unknown, rate null, acquired null; tax_cost omitted (not asserted).
FY 2025-26 (fy 2026): unknown_count 1 -> complete false; tax, cess, total null.
